# DNS_ZONE

The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

Canonically `zone`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.zone`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

## Fields

| field | type |
| --- | --- |
| port | port (1-65535) |
| server | string |
| zone | DNS name |
